name: OENORM B 2061 — Preisermittlung fuer Bauleistungen
description: Reference document for OENORM B 2061, which asks that a tender price is built up rather than presented as a single opaque figure. The standard separates the direct costs of the individual items (Einzelkosten der Teilleistungen) from site overheads (Baustellengemeinkosten), business overheads (Geschaeftsgemeinkosten), risk and profit, and carries that build-up on the K-Blaetter (Kalkulationsformblaetter). This structure is specific to Austria and differs from both the German and the Swiss approach, so the standard asks that each component is stated, that the K-Blatt accompanying the offer is present, and that what it shows reconciles with the priced bill. That build-up is not implemented as a rule here. What the pack checks is the priced bill underneath it: that positions carry a unit rate, that totals reconcile, and that currency is consistent.
review_status: Regulatory references are drawn from public sources and are pending review by an Austrian Baukalkulator or Ziviltechniker before they are relied on for a public submission. No edition year is pinned here; the edition in force must be confirmed against Austrian Standards International.
